{{Top|leg}}
'''Shinos''' was a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who trained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Shinos encountered the hermit [[Spindrall]], who lived in the tombs of the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]], and Spindrall only allowed Shinos to leave if the acolyte promised to send Spindrall's "final gift" to [[Darth Nox|Darth Zash's apprentice]], who he called "the one who will shape fates both future and ancient."
